extracted_details.description_text: This is the Surface Integration Driver, version 120.8.4.0, dated 05/06/2026 in the supplied INF. INFDescriptionData was semantically analyzed and identifies ACPI\MSHW0530, a demand-start kernel service, three Windows power-policy provisioning packages, KIP support, display energy-estimation settings, and BitLocker request limits. No exact-version Surface release notes or Surface driver family page were verified. The provided Intel Management Engine and chipset links are for different driver products, so the Intel page's current version 2618.9.30.0 is not a valid previous/latest fallback for this Surface package; no release-note changes are attributed to version 120.8.4.0.
key_components: SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys, installed as a demand-start kernel driver for ACPI\MSHW0530
Default Surface power-policy provisioning package and the Windows 10 and Windows 11 variants
DisplayPanelPowerFloor, DisplayPanelPowerVsyncDelta, DisplayPanelPowerDpiFactor, and DisplayPanelPowerAreaFactor values, all set to zero
BitLocker fvevol MaxEncryptRequests, MaxCryptoRequestsPerIo, and MaxDecryptRequests values set to 0x40
key_functionalities: Matches the Surface Integration device ACPI\MSHW0530 on the INF-declared 64-bit Windows 10.0 build 19041-or-later target.
Installs SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys as a demand-start kernel service.
Registers default, Windows 10, and Windows 11 power-policy provisioning package paths.
Enables the platform KIP-supported setting; the INF comment says this enables KIP power-saving features.
Provides a 14-point brightness-to-backlight-power curve for Windows display energy estimation.
Sets UserBatteryDischargeEstimator to 0xFFFFFFFF to hide the estimated remaining battery discharge time.
Enables screen refresh on a long press of the power button.
Sets BitLocker encryption, decryption, and per-I/O crypto request limits to 0x40; the INF comment identifies the encryption request limit as intended to improve SSD performance under BitLocker.
extracted_details.major_components_functionalities_descrip: This enrichment is based on the exact supplied version 120.8.4.0 and the complete INFDescriptionData, which was semantically analyzed. The INF identifies ACPI\MSHW0530 and installs SurfaceIntegrationDriver.sys as a demand-start kernel service for 64-bit Windows systems matching its build decoration. It registers default and OS-specific Windows power-policy provisioning packages and enables the platform KIP-supported setting. It also configures a 14-point display backlight power curve, battery-discharge estimate visibility, and screen refresh after a long power-button press. The INF sets BitLocker encryption, decryption, and per-I/O crypto request limits to 0x40, with an SSD-performance rationale stated for the encryption request limit. No exact or valid same-family previous/latest release notes were found, so these are INF-described package behaviors and not claimed version-specific fixes.
impact_details: May affect platform KIP power-saving behavior because the INF enables PlatformKipSupported and explicitly associates it with KIP power-saving features.
May affect Windows display energy estimates through the configured brightness-to-backlight-power curve and zeroed panel estimation factors.
Changes the displayed estimated remaining battery discharge time by setting UserBatteryDischargeEstimator to 0xFFFFFFFF.
Enables the configured screen-refresh behavior following a long press of the power button.
May affect storage performance during BitLocker activity; the INF explicitly states that the encryption request limit is set to improve SSD performance.
Changes the configured maximum BitLocker encrypt, decrypt, and per-I/O crypto requests to 64.
